title: 041 - Factorial Base Case
prompt: Fix the bug so the program compute factorial(5) and print 120 and prints exactly `120`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
<?php

function factorialBaseCase(array $scores, array $weights): int
{
    $total = 0;
    foreach ($scores as $index => $score) {
        $total += $score * $weights[$index];
    }
    return intdiv($total, count($scores));
}
solutionCode:
<?php

function factorialBaseCase(array $scores, array $weights): int
{
    $total = 0;
    foreach ($scores as $index => $score) {
        $total += $score * $weights[$index];
    }
    return intdiv($total, array_sum($weights));
}
hint: The base case should not return zero.
explanation: The broken recursive base case returns the wrong identity value. Returning 1 fixes the multiplication chain.
